name: open-ALERT
tagline: A configurator for ALERT and ALERT2 flood-warning sites: say what a site must do, see the hardware that fits, its costs and consequences.
about: For anyone planning ALERT or ALERT2 field stations, repeaters or base stations. Each site goes from needs to requirements to hardware picked from a 250-part catalogue (open and closed, Raspberry Pi to industrial), then to a bill of materials, a power budget with battery and panel sized, labour and running costs, and the consequences of the choices. The Network tab adds sites up and checks that what field stations send, repeaters relay and bases receive actually meet. A static page with no server: state lives in the browser and in share links. The base station builder (build.html) goes deeper on a receiving base running RPi ALERT: how it fits together physically and in the code, which computer keeps up with how many channels, the SDR mounting, a bill with price ranges, lead times and suppliers, and the build steps.

status.summary: Added the base station builder (build.html): system and physical diagrams, a stick planner and CPU model from RPi ALERT's measurements, a bill with price ranges, lead times and where to buy, the build steps, and the custom path off the Raspberry Pi (CM5, Verdin AM62 + Mallow, an M.2 SDR card, a carrier of your own). The RPi ALERT entry is up to 0.15.3.

components.name: Rules engine
components.what: Needs → requirements → per-slot fit → supporting parts → power, cost and consequences.

components.name: Hardware catalogue
components.what: 250 parts in six family files, each with price and its source, power, temperature, grade, openness and sources.

components.name: ALERT equipment and software
components.what: ERT-A2, Campbell and HSE units, encoders and base-station software — where the sibling repositories are cited.

components.name: Presets and example networks
components.what: 22 preset sites and 5 example networks as starting points; buyable ones must meet every must.

components.name: Configurator page
components.what: Configure, Network, Hardware catalogue and How it works tabs; state in localStorage and share links.

components.name: Base station builder
components.what: build.html: how a receiving base fits together, the stick planner and CPU model, the bill with price ranges, lead times and suppliers, the build steps and the custom path.

components.name: Network check
components.what: Adds sites up by quantity and checks field stations, repeaters and bases meet on protocol and path.

components.name: Tests
components.what: node --test: every record and reference, every preset, and the sizing, pricing and network rules.

components.name: Publishing
components.what: Deploys site/ to GitHub Pages on every push to main, only if the tests pass.

components.name: open-ALERT encoder and repeater
components.what: An open ALERT1 encoder for a $10 board and a Pi store-and-forward repeater — catalogued, not written.

provides.name: ALERT hardware catalogue
provides.what: Plain-JavaScript records of 250 parts with prices and their sources, power, grades and links, for costing ALERT sites.

provides.name: open-ALERT configurator
provides.what: The page itself, and share links to a configured site or network.

provides.name: Base station builder
provides.what: A page for planning and building one ALERT receiving base station on RPi ALERT, from parts to readings in Flood-Net.

consumes.what: RPi ALERT's catalogue entry and notes: version, receivers it reads, protocols, platforms, hardware and clock notes.
consumes.on_change: Update the rpi-alert record in site/data/alert.js (fw.name version, reads, decodes, grade, cons) and the RPi ALERT notes in compute.js, radio.js and site.js; run npm test.

consumes.what: The UV-K5 V3 / UV-K1 receiver entry: how to flash it, its serial interface, its on-air status.
consumes.on_change: Update quansheng-uv-k5-v3 in site/data/radio.js (fw.note, status, cons); run npm test.

consumes.what: The DP32G030 UV-K5 entry: archived but flashable, read through a K-plug cable at 38,400 baud.
consumes.on_change: Update quansheng-uv-k5-dp32 in site/data/radio.js; run npm test.

consumes.what: The FW-LAB Receiver entry and the GNU Radio lab base preset: SDRs, platforms, MQTT output.
consumes.on_change: Update fwlab-receiver in site/data/alert.js and base-fwlab-x86 in site/js/presets.js (status eol if the repository is archived); run npm test.

consumes.what: ALERT frame formats (ABF, EIF, framing, CRC) cited for the planned open encoder.
consumes.on_change: Re-check the oa-encoder and diy-minimodem-encoder records in site/data/alert.js.

consumes.what: ALERT2 transition plan planning prices, ALERT1 tones and timing, the Serial Monitor entry, and Flood-Net as the destination (HTTPS, MQTT, HFEM, 115E-2-A2 bridge).
consumes.on_change: Update the PLAN-priced records in site/data/alert.js and site/data/site.js (and usdPerAud in site/js/engine.js), the floodnet-serial-monitor record, and the Flood-Net outputs in engine.js; run npm test.

consumes.what: The builder's stick windows, channel costs, burst cost and install routes: RPi ALERT's hardware notes, how it works, its installer and its SDR worker.
consumes.on_change: Re-check model.windows, chCore240, burstCoreS and kioskCore in site/data/builder.js and the steps() text in site/js/builder.js; run npm test.
